# Configure

<!-- arlotope:contract (generated by `arlo docs` from workflow/) -->
**First, load the brief:** `uv run --with pyyaml python arlo.py brief configure [--study <slug>]`; skip when `ARLOTOPE BRIEF /configure` is already supplied. Follow its task ownership, additions and checkpoints.
<!-- /arlotope:contract -->

Use `docs/configuration.md` for key ownership, layering and profiles. Values belong in
configuration files, not skills. Existing project environments and structure stay intact.

## Inspect

Run `uv run --with pyyaml python tools/configure.py view`. Add `--project <slug>` for a project;
resolve its path from `arlo.py studies --json`. An experiment filename adds its resolved parameters.
Show only the relevant values and their sources.

## Change a value

1. Identify the requested key and correct layer: Lab settings, project `control.yaml`, or a new
   experiment config. Run configs already used are immutable. `configs/base.yaml` may also supply
   experiment defaults; trust the resolved provenance rather than guessing.
2. Respect ownership in `workflow/rules.yaml` (`pi_owned_config`) and the configuration reference.
   PI-owned changes require the PI's explicit request; existing authorization is sufficient.
   Never clear `eval_frozen`, widen budgets or enable autonomy on your own. A setting grants no
   checkpoint approval. Workflow definitions are edited separately under **Workflow**.
3. Apply through `tools/configure.py set <key=value> [--project <slug>] [--pi-approved]`.
   Use `--pi-approved` only for an authorized change. The tool checks ownership and preserves
   comments. It also synchronizes generated role files after `agents.*` changes; do not edit
   those files manually. Tier names resolve through `agents.tiers`; critic bindings resolve at spawn.
4. Read the resolved view again, report the change and record it in the notebook.

## Profiles

Use `tools/profiles.py list` to discover available profiles, then `show <name>` or `diff <name>`.
Budget tiers scale exploration; engine profiles select agent settings. They may be combined.
For an explicitly requested `apply`, show the diff before applying it. Ask only if that diff includes
an additional decision the PI has not authorized. Use `save <name>` only on the PI's request.
The tool preserves comments, synchronizes role files and rejects reductions below integrity floors.

If a project lacks `control.yaml`, explain the missing layer. Add a scaffold only when the PI asks
for the structured research pipeline; preserve the project's existing files.
